meta.title: User Rules Injector
meta.description: Stores your own long-lived rules locally and injects them into the system prompt of every model request. Per-rule enable, ordering, global or workspace scope, plus a graphical management page, a /rules command and a user_rules tool.

panel.title: User Rules
panel.subtitle: Rules are injected into the system prompt; every model request after this one obeys them.
panel.empty: No rules yet. Add one below, for example "Always answer in Chinese" or "Run the tests before touching code".
panel.enabledAllHint: When off, no rule is injected at all.
panel.placeholder: Write one rule — the more concrete, the better it is obeyed…
panel.noWorkspace: Session workspace not known yet - only global rules for now (hit Refresh to retry).
panel.help: Rules are injected top to bottom. Global rules apply to every session; workspace rules apply only to sessions whose workspace path matches.
